status: planned: no picture made yet. Making the twelve needs image-model spend or a commission, which is Guy's call; until a topic ships, the Now guide card keeps its own shapes and medallion.
model: gemini-3-pro-image (planned, as for parent-art-v1; a commission replaces it if chosen)
method: Text-only prompts, no reference image of any family, child or avatar. One or more candidates per topic, the best chosen by eye and checked for no person, face, hand or text; exported to 960x540 and 480x270 WebP, each at most 120 KB. Style brief: app/public/visuals/guides/README.md.
rules: Objects only: never a person, a face, a hand, an animal or toy with a face, a letter, a number or a logo; no text in any picture, so one file serves EN and HE; the left (inline-start) 45% stays calm for the title, and the app mirrors the picture in RTL.
